findings.title: Agent paused mid-reply for 2.21s, then resumed
findings.summary: At 3:15.9 the agent stopped speaking because of user voice activity that never produced a transcript, then resumed the same reply 2.21s later.

evidence.label: Agent reply affected
evidence.value: Yes, that works perfectly. I'll take the Tuesday at 8 AM.

root_cause.statement: Possible acoustic echo: the trigger began 0.32s after the agent started speaking, which fits the agent's own voice reaching the microphone.
missing_evidence: Microphone audio at the trigger time
The same script re-run with headphones

next_steps: Listen to the microphone channel at the trigger time.
Re-run the same script with headphones and compare false-interruption counts.
Lower false_interruption_timeout (default 2.0s) to shorten the gap, or raise min_interruption_duration if short sounds are the trigger.
